fetchedAt.title: Fetchedat

CourseFilter.description:
Courses picked by subject, number range, attribute or level rather than
by name ("any MATH course numbered 1038 to 4999", "2000+ ARTH elective").
CourseFilter.title: CourseFilter

CourseOption.description:
One choosable option within a requirement item.

A single option can contain multiple corequisite courses that must
be taken together (e.g. CHEM 1031 & CHEM 1033).
CourseOption.title: CourseOption

CourseRef.description: A reference to a single course in the bulletin.
CourseRef.title: CourseRef

DegreeProgram.description:
Complete degree requirements scraped from a Temple Bulletin page.

This is the top-level structure returned by the parser.
DegreeProgram.title: DegreeProgram

Interpretation.description: How much of a passage the structured form captures.
Interpretation.title: Interpretation

LabScienceSequence.description:
A lab-science department sequence (e.g. Biology, Chemistry, Physics).

The student picks one sequence, then selects one course from A
and one from B within that sequence.
LabScienceSequence.title: LabScienceSequence

PlanCourse.description: A single slot in the suggested academic plan grid.
PlanCourse.title: PlanCourse

PlanSemester.description: One semester in the suggested plan.
PlanSemester.title: PlanSemester

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem details. `detail`, when present, is safe to show users.
Problem.title: Problem

ProblemError.description: One validation error: a JSON Pointer into the body, or a parameter.

in.description: Parameter location: query, path, header or cookie.
in.title: In

ProblemError.title: ProblemError

RequirementCategory.description:
A top-level requirement section.

Maps to the numbered <ol> items on the bulletin:
  1. University Requirements
  2. College Requirements
  3. Major Requirements for Bachelor of Science
RequirementCategory.title: RequirementCategory

RequirementGroup.description:
A named cluster of requirement items within a category.

Examples: "Computer & Information Science courses",
"Computer Science Electives", "Mathematics", "Laboratory Science courses".
RequirementGroup.title: RequirementGroup

RequirementItem.description:
A single line-item in a requirement group.

Covers three patterns found on the bulletin:
  - REQUIRED:   take this exact course (options has 1 entry with 1 course)
  - SELECT_ONE: pick one option from the list (e.g. CIS 1051 or CIS 1951)
  - SELECT_N:   pick N credits worth from the options pool
RequirementItem.title: RequirementItem

RequirementNode.description: One node of a program's requirement tree.
RequirementNode.title: RequirementNode

RequirementTree.description:
A program version's requirements: one root per requirement table, in page
order, under the headings and tab the table sits in.
RequirementTree.title: RequirementTree

RequisiteExpression.description: A course's prerequisite or corequisite condition.
RequisiteExpression.title: RequisiteExpression

Section-Input.description: One meeting block of a section. A CRN with several blocks sends one entry per block.

scheduleType.description: Banner schedule type (Lecture, Laboratory…). Each type is scheduled separately.
scheduleType.title: Scheduletype

Section-Input.title: Section

Section-Output.description: One meeting block of a section. A CRN with several blocks sends one entry per block.

scheduleType.description: Banner schedule type (Lecture, Laboratory…). Each type is scheduled separately.
scheduleType.title: Scheduletype

Section-Output.title: Section

SelectionType.description: How the student fulfills a requirement item.
SelectionType.title: SelectionType

SourceRef.description: A passage in a stored snapshot (see the ingester's `Evidence`).
SourceRef.title: SourceRef

SuggestedPlan.description: The 4-year suggested academic plan grid from the bulletin.
SuggestedPlan.title: SuggestedPlan

Validation.description: What has checked the structured form against its source.
Validation.title: Validation
